_what: Kill-test fixture for check_release_debt.py. Every case must PASS clean; check_gate_selftests.py mutates one case per kill-test. merge-shape: a 2-commit branch merged --no-ff after v1.0.0 is ONE first-parent commit (3 in all), so max 1 passes only under first-parent counting. release-prep: 31 first-parent commits past v1.0.0 pass ONLY through the exemption (a PATCH bump, so a major-only comparison fails it). side-branch-tag: an older tag v1.0.1 on a branch merged after v2.0.0 must not be chosen as T (git describe chooses it, C-116); the true debt is 36 past v2.0.0. non-release-tags: v*-tags that are not vX.Y.Z (a spike tag, a pre-release, an annotation tag on the release commit with a later date, a leading-zero name) must be ignored, not chosen and not exit 2. numeric-order: v1.10.0 is a higher release than v1.9.0 although its NAME sorts lower; the true debt is 3 past v1.10.0 (choosing T by name picks v1.9.0, and the exemption then passes any debt).
